rows.title: 按实际可见前景修正保护范围 · 最新
rows.principle: 原投影人物与暗前景代理保护过宽，让清晰地面漏约束。以同一目标视角结果中的人物和影子估计可见前景，统一保留32px安全边距，再按原规则编码保护掩码；只换掩码，其他DD条件与真实背景参考缓存相同。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 明显背景漂移已减轻；清晰交线2.25→0.25px。人物与动态影子保留，近身细微亮暗仍待全速验收。

floor_measurement.limits: Local endpoint edge measures only; frames crossed by actor, feet or moving cast shadow are not interpreted as camera jitter.

remaining_limits: Fine residual intensity change near actor, feet and moving cast-shadow boundaries remains; cannot infer zero flicker from endpoint metrics or contact sheets.
No human full-speed subjective video acceptance claimed; browser decode/play checks are separate.
Visible foreground is estimated from prior generated RGB and Stage2 reference, not GT; guard should be recomputed per case.
Previously hidden background is estimated from case-specific reference; no generalization claim.

rows.title: 清理残留旧保护区 · 同噪声对照
rows.principle: 开头未遮挡文字被旧warp近身保护误覆盖。保持人物核心、目标影子核心及其时间窗口不变，只移除旧额外保护；模型、输入、提示词、噪声及实际背景参考缓存相同。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 开头文字漏约束已改善，人物和移动影子保留；中部地面小范围残余位移继续处理

rows.title: 修正保护掩码 · 屋顶漏约束修复
rows.principle: 旧掩码把重投影黑边显隐误判成阴影，漏掉了清晰屋顶。保留人物和移动影子保护，仅换掩码；DD、输入、提示词、噪声、静态参考与约束强度都相同。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 修正前景误判后屋顶明显稳定；人物与动态影子保留，仍需检查全速细微闪动

original_DD81.limits: Common NEW target-view background mask estimated from previous actual DD output and preserved original projected body support. Not ground-truth segmentation. Same masks used for all outputs. Includes appearance drift and geometry; not global camera motion. Actor/shadow deformation requires manual review.

previous_mask_DD.limits: Common NEW target-view background mask estimated from previous actual DD output and preserved original projected body support. Not ground-truth segmentation. Same masks used for all outputs. Includes appearance drift and geometry; not global camera motion. Actor/shadow deformation requires manual review.

repaired_mask_DD.limits: Common NEW target-view background mask estimated from previous actual DD output and preserved original projected body support. Not ground-truth segmentation. Same masks used for all outputs. Includes appearance drift and geometry; not global camera motion. Actor/shadow deformation requires manual review.

clean_reference_static_VAE_only.limits: Common NEW target-view background mask estimated from previous actual DD output and preserved original projected body support. Not ground-truth segmentation. Same masks used for all outputs. Includes appearance drift and geometry; not global camera motion. Actor/shadow deformation requires manual review.

visual_review.limits: New mask is estimated, not ground-truth segmentation. Static-only VAE videos are zero-DD diagnostics, not new Stage3 candidates. First9-frame roof interval is manually unoccluded; later hands and shadows must remain dynamic.

rows.title: 固定背景几何＋持续Stage2参考
rows.principle: 先固定背景深度与有效区域，再在整段人物和移动影子都不会扫过的24.1%区域，持续约束Stage2外观；本行基线已使用相同几何修正，仅比较新增外观约束。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 背景明显更稳定，人物和移动影子仍在；右侧及中部残余变化尚待修复

rows.title: 扩大范围：固定背景几何输入
rows.principle: 逐帧保护人物深度，固定其余已观测背景的深度和有效区域，平均背景权重79%；源RGB保持原样，人物和影子继续运动。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 固定逐帧背景几何后变化减小，墙面位置及亮度慢漂移仍未消除

rows.title: 编码前固定背景几何条件
rows.principle: 仅固定左侧静态背景的原始深度图和掩码，再通过未修改的DD几何编码器推理；其余源视频、prompt、噪声和模型相同，用于检查背景条件变化的影响。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 编码前固定左侧几何条件后局部帧间变化降低，亮度慢漂移仍在

rows.title: 固定背景几何特征
rows.principle: 仅在保守静态左侧区域，让各时刻的相机条件特征使用首时刻值，检查几何条件变化的影响。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 复制首时刻相机特征使背景更不稳定，未通过

rows.title: 去噪时约束静态背景
rows.principle: 每步去噪仅在保守左侧背景区域约束到Stage2静态参考，人物和影子扫过区域不直接修改。

visual_review.verdict_zh: 左侧背景变化明显减少；整幅背景尚未修好
